description: Declaration of which schema contexts own a canonical slug, per common-fields.md 3.0.3. The owning object and the DTOs that create, update or project that one object use the bare name `slug`; every other context references it as `<entity>_slug` with an optional role/time qualifier. The check closes the wire surface against this registry in both directions: a bare `slug` outside a registered owning context fails, a registered context whose pointer no longer resolves fails, and an `<entity>_slug` reference to an entity with no registered owning context fails.

owning_contexts.reason: agent_projection is the materialized projection of the Agent object; 3.0.3 requires the projecting DTO to reuse the object's own bare slug field name.
agent_provision_request_body creates the Agent object and carries exactly one slug semantics, so 3.0.3 requires the same bare slug name as the materialized field.
